title: The 'Save What's Left' Trap Is Stealing $384K
hook: If you wait until month-end to save whatever's left, you're probably saving almost nothing — and that habit has a $384,000 price tag.
angle: The order of operations between spending and saving determines your financial future — and most people get it backwards every single month.
audience: Millennials and Gen Z earners who intend to save but spend everything before month-end
key_numbers: $314/month difference compounds to $384,000 over 30 years at 7%
